mapper.insert: INSERT INTO summary_nodes (id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, parent_id, node_type, level, chunk_index, start_chunk_index, end_chunk_index, content, char_count, token_count, metadata) VALUES (#{id}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{parentId}, 'LEAF', 0, #{chunkIndex}, #{startChunkIndex}, #{endChunkIndex}, #{content}, #{charCount}, #{tokenCount}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO summary_nodes (id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, parent_id, node_type, level, chunk_index, start_chunk_index, end_chunk_index, content, char_count, token_count, metadata) VALUES
(#{n.id}, #{n.knowledgeBaseId}, #{n.documentId}, #{n.parentId}, 'LEAF', 0, #{n.chunkIndex}, #{n.startChunkIndex}, #{n.endChunkIndex}, #{n.content}, #{n.charCount}, #{n.tokenCount}, CAST(#{n.metadata} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO summary_nodes (id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, parent_id, node_type, level, start_chunk_index, end_chunk_index, content, summary, char_count, token_count, embedding, cluster_label, cluster_size, metadata) VALUES (#{id}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{documentId}, #{parentId}, 'SUMMARY', #{level}, #{startChunkIndex}, #{endChunkIndex}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{charCount}, #{tokenCount}, CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), #{clusterLabel}, #{clusterSize}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE summary_nodes SET embedding = CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE summary_nodes SET parent_id = NULL WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'LEAF'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'SUMMARY'
mapper.update: UPDATE summary_nodes SET metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'LEAF' AND embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chunk_index
SELECT * FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'LEAF' ORDER BY chunk_index
SELECT * FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'LEAF' AND embedding IS NULL ORDER BY chunk_index
SELECT * FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'SUMMARY' ORDER BY level, created_at

SELECT s.id AS node_id, s.node_type AS node_type, s.level AS level, s.document_id AS document_id, d.file_name AS document_name, d.enabled AS document_enabled, s.chunk_index AS chunk_index, s.start_chunk_index AS start_chunk_index, s.end_chunk_index AS end_chunk_index, s.char_count AS char_count, s.content AS content, 1 - (s.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector)) AS raw_score FROM summary_nodes s JOIN document d ON d.id = s.document_id AND d.enabled = TRUE WHERE s.embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryVector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS node_id, s.node_type AS node_type, s.level AS level, s.document_id AS document_id, d.file_name AS document_name, d.enabled AS document_enabled, s.chunk_index AS chunk_index, s.start_chunk_index AS start_chunk_index, s.end_chunk_index AS end_chunk_index, s.char_count AS char_count, s.content AS content, paradedb.score(s.id) AS raw_score FROM summary_nodes s JOIN document d ON d.id = s.document_id AND d.enabled = TRUE WHERE s.id @@@ paradedb.match('content', #{query})
ORDER BY paradedb.score(s.id) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, parent_id FROM summary_nodes WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{kbId}

SELECT s.id AS node_id, s.document_id AS document_id, d.file_name AS document_name, s.knowledge_base_id AS knowledge_base_id, s.node_type AS node_type, s.level AS level, s.chunk_index AS chunk_index, s.start_chunk_index AS start_chunk_index, s.end_chunk_index AS end_chunk_index, s.char_count AS char_count, s.token_count AS token_count, s.parent_id AS parent_id, (s.embedding IS NOT NULL) AS has_embedding, vector_dims(s.embedding) AS embedding_dimension, left(s.embedding::text, 320) AS embedding_preview, s.content AS content, s.created_at AS created_at FROM summary_nodes s LEFT JOIN document d ON d.id = s.document_id WHERE s.node_type = 'LEAF' AND s.document_id = #{documentId} AND s.knowledge_base_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY s.document_id, s.chunk_index LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT level AS level, count(*) AS count FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} GROUP BY level ORDER BY level
SELECT count(*) FROM summary_nodes WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{kbId}
SELECT count(*) FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = #{nodeType}
SELECT count(*) FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND level = #{level}
SELECT metadata::text FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'SUMMARY' AND parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY level DESC, cluster_size DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'SUMMARY' AND metadata ->> #{key} = 'true'
SELECT avg(cluster_size) FROM summary_nodes WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND node_type = 'SUMMARY'
